name: wave6-node-api-hardening
scope: Local createApp instance. Public deployment remains GitHub Pages (static HTTPS). Node binds loopback unless HTTPS PUBLIC_ORIGIN + SIGHTLINE_TOKEN.

detail.content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; frame-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

production_debug.evidence: fail() returns fixed message catalog only; unit + this harness assert no stack/endpoint leakage
production_debug.node_env_guard: Prototype/server/index.mjs refuses non-loopback production bind without HTTPS PUBLIC_ORIGIN

public_https.node_api: Not publicly hosted on this candidate; loopback default; HTTPS origin required beyond 127.0.0.1
